testcase.name: a blast built from a definition carries that utility's wire id for the kill feed
damage falls off linearly from the centre to zero at the radius
knockback points away from the detonation and keeps bite at the edge
a zero-radius blast is a bug, not a point explosion
resolving against nothing yields nothing instead of failing
the thrower is not spared by their own grenade
terrain blocks blast damage entirely, however close the detonation was
every live target in range is hit exactly once, and nobody else is
standing exactly on a grenade gets launched upward rather than dividing by zero
